Package org.apache.juneau.commons.logging

Class LogRecordCapture

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.commons.logging.LogRecordCapture
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, LogRecordListener
public class LogRecordCapture extends Object implements LogRecordListener, Closeable
Captures log records for testing purposes.

This class implements LogRecordListener to receive log records and stores them in memory for inspection during tests. It implements Closeable to automatically remove itself from the logger's listeners when closed.

Usage:

// Capture records using try-with-resources try (LogRecordCapture capture = RichLogger.getLogger(MyClass.class).captureEvents()) { logger.info("Test message"); logger.warning("Warning message"); // Inspect captured records List<LogRecord> records = capture.getRecords(); assertEquals(2, records.size()); // Get formatted messages List<String> messages = capture.getRecords("{level}: {msg}"); assertEquals("INFO: Test message", messages.get(0)); }

Format String:

The format string supports placeholders as documented in LogRecord.formatted(String).

  • Method Details

    • quietly

      public static List<LogRecord> quietly(String loggerName, Snippet body)
      Runs a block while capturing, and keeping off the console, everything logged to the named logger or any of its descendants.

      Unlike RichLogger.captureEvents(), which only observes records, this also stops the logger's records from reaching the parent (console) handlers for the duration of the block. The logger's previous parent-handler setting is restored in a finally block.

      List<LogRecord> records = LogRecordCapture.quietly(MyClass.class, () -> obj.doSomethingThatWarns()); assertEquals(1, records.size());

      Parameters:
      loggerName - The logger name. Records from descendant loggers are captured too.
      body - The code to run. Checked exceptions are rethrown wrapped in a RuntimeException.
      Returns:
      The captured records, in the order logged. Never null.

    • quiet

      public static LogRecordCapture.Quiet quiet(String loggerName)
      Keeps everything logged to the named logger, and its descendants, off the console until the returned handle is closed.

      Use this when a whole test class (for example from @BeforeAll / @AfterAll) expects a warning it is not asserting on. Calls nest and may overlap across threads: the logger's original parent-handler setting is restored when the last outstanding handle for that logger name is closed.

      Parameters:
      loggerName - The logger name.
      Returns:
      A handle that restores the logger when closed. Never null.

    • contextValue

      public Object contextValue(LogRecord rec, String key)
      Returns the value of a LogContext entry attached to the specified captured record.

      Convenience over LogRecordContext.of(java.util.logging.LogRecord) so capture-based tests do not need to know about the side table directly.

      Parameters:
      rec - The captured record.
      key - The context key.
      Returns:
      The attached value for the key, or null if not present.
